verdict.rationale: xAI documents a dedicated Batch API for processing large volumes of requests asynchronously with "reduced pricing and higher rate limits." Per-model spec pages also list Batch API support status, so the core of the story is first-party documented. Missing for 10: the specific batch discount rate or batch price table versus real-time token prices, details of the batch job workflow (submission format, completion window), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
